::: {.Results title="Where these numbers come from"}
Every number in this section is quoted from the published article [@flash2015rush], with its place there. None was produced by the code in this repository, which has not been run on the study data. The tables are rebuilt from the values the article prints, typed in from it, and laid out by the same functions that `R/tables.R` applies to the data; the article's own typeset tables and Figure 1 are in the [article](https://doi.org/10.1097/QAI.0000000000000578) (author manuscript in [PubMed Central](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4482220/)).
:::

These pages map each reported result to the step of the code that computes it, so that a reader can see what each number is and an authorized analyst can check the R version against the article. This page has the cohort and Table 1; each outcome has its own page, with the article's table and a forest plot of its odds ratios:

- [Engagement in care](published_engagement.qmd): the article's Table 2
- [Retention in care](published_retention.qmd): Table 3
- [Viral suppression](published_suppression.qmd): Table 4

## The cohort

| Result (article, Results, first two paragraphs) | Computed by |
|---|---|
| 202,767 HIV tests; 3,613 confirmed positive; 2,958 positives in 2,188 previously diagnosed people; 2,687 at least a year after diagnosis; 2,068 patients | Before the analysis, when the workbooks were built; not in the code |
| 65% male; 68% Black, 17% Hispanic, 13% White non-Hispanic | Counts printed by [`describe-study-cohort`](01_import_data.qmd#describe-the-study-cohort) |
| Table 1 (both cohorts by sex, race, year, age group and years since diagnosis) | [Tables](tables.qmd#count-table-1) |
| Mean age 43 ± 10 years | Not in the code: the workbooks hold age groups only |
| Median 9 years since diagnosis; 63% diagnosed 1 to 10 years before | [`describe-study-cohort`](01_import_data.qmd#describe-the-study-cohort) (summary of `years_since_dx` and counts by group) |
| 672 patients with a pre-RUSH visit | Rows in `control_wide`; [`define-era-samples`](05_compare_eras.qmd#two-samples) prints patients by number of rows |

```{r}
#| label: read-published-values
#| eval: true
#| include: false
# Reads only the two files of values typed in from the article, and defines
# the table functions; reads no study data and fits nothing.
source("_published_values.R")
```

## Table 1. Characteristics of the study cohort and the control period subset

```{r}
#| label: show-table-1
#| eval: true
format_table_1(
  published_table_1,
  study_header = "**Study period cohort (N = 2068)**",
  control_header = "**Control period cohort subset (N = 672)**"
)
```

Source: the article's Table 1. As printed, the study cohort's "21+" years-since-diagnosis row reads 167 (13%), although 167 of 2,068 is 8%; and 367 of 672 controls in 2007 reads 54%, where the quotient rounds to 55%.
